name: US Government Crypto Wallet
rootCause: On 2024-10-24, roughly $20 million in USDC, USDT, aUSDC, and ETH moved from a U.S. government linked Ethereum wallet associated with seized Bitfinex assets. Public reporting and on-chain monitoring flagged the transfers as unauthorized, but the exact authorization failure has not been publicly established. Most reports later stated that approximately $19.3 million was returned within a day. The exact authorization failure remains unknown. Public reporting described the event as a likely wallet compromise affecting a U.S. government linked Ethereum address that held seized Bitfinex assets.
